Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- (ii) on temporary transfer on foreign service to Bodies (incorporated or not) wholly or substantially owned or controlled by Government and Organizations, e.g., Municipalities, Universities, etc.  
Deputation (Duty) Allowance is treated as 'Special Pay' as defined in FR 9 (25).  
- (b) Period of Deputation.The period of deputation/foreign service shall be as per the Recruitment Rules of the ex cadre post or 5 years in case no tenure regulations exist for the ex cadre post.
